summary: A cornhole board is 48 by 24 in (1.22 x 0.61 m) with a 6 in hole about 6 in from the top, per the cornhole.com FAQ (reported opened by a second research engine, not by Claude). The library piece is one board, tilted. The board height (0.31 m back, 0.08 m front) is an ESTIMATE, not from a page, and the official playing distance was not found. Players need two boards a few metres apart; place two pieces facing each other. Indoors or on a lawn.

sources.title: FAQ (Cornhole.com)
sources.note: Reported verbatim: each wood board measures 48 inches by 24 inches with a 6 inch hole approximately 6 inches from the top of the board.
